controles.verbatim_source: "The Company is a party to litigation and other disputes that arise in the ordinary course of business. While the outcome of any particular lawsuit or dispute cannot be predicted with certainty, in the opinion of management, the Company's currently pending litigation and disputes are not expected to have a material adverse effect on the Company's consolidated financial position, results of operations, or liquidity." controles.affirmation: Taux de location 98,4% pour les ancres contre 93,4% pour les boutiques au 30/06/2026 (98,4% vs 93,0% fin 2025)
controles.verbatim_source: "Percent Leased - All Properties 96.5% | 96.3% ; Anchor Space (spaces >= 10,000 SF) 98.4% | 98.4% ; Shop Space (spaces < 10,000 SF) 93.4% | 93.0%" (10-Q T2 2026, colonnes 30 juin 2026 et 31 decembre 2025)

controles.affirmation: "16,98 $ par pied carre en TRAVAUX D'AMENAGEMENT ET COMMISSIONS LOCATIVES pour les baux de boutiques, contre 4,42 $ pour les baux d'ancres, soit pres de 4 fois plus"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, tableau d'activite locative six mois : "Total Anchor Space Leases (...) Tenant Allowance and Landlord Work PSF $ 4.42 | Leasing Commissions PSF $ 1.55" ; "Total Shop Space Leases (...) Tenant Allowance and Landlord Work PSF $ 16.98 | Leasing Commissions PSF $ 7.20"
controles.correction_proposee: 16,98 $ et 4,42 $ sont uniquement la colonne "Tenant Allowance and Landlord Work" (travaux d'amenagement) ; les commissions locatives forment une colonne distincte (7,20 $ boutiques, 1,55 $ ancres). Reformulation exacte : travaux d'amenagement 16,98 $/pi2 contre 4,42 $/pi2 (3,8x) ; en incluant les commissions, 24,18 $/pi2 contre 5,97 $/pi2 (4,1x).

controles.affirmation: Besoin d'environ 1,4 Md$ de capital sur 12 mois, expose aux tarifs douaniers et a l'inflation des couts de construction
controles.verbatim_source: "we estimate that we will require capital during the next 12 months of approximately $1.4 billion related to leasing commissions, tenant improvements, in-process developments and redevelopments, capital contributions to our real estate partnerships, and repaying maturing debt. These capital requirements may be impacted by increased costs of construction caused by, without limitation, tariffs and inflation affecting materials, labor, and services from third-party contractors and suppliers." (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: 393,9 M$ de developpements et 285,8 M$ de redeveloppements en cours, avec 45% et 54% des couts engages
controles.verbatim_source: "Total Developments In-Process (...) $ 393,903 (...) 45 %" ; "Total Redevelopments In-Process (...) $ 285,834 (...) 54 %" (10-Q T2 2026, en milliers de dollars)

controles.affirmation: Conflit militaire impliquant les Etats-Unis, Israel et l'Iran signale comme facteur de risque aggrave depuis le 10-K
controles.verbatim_source: "Since the filing of our Form 10-K, a significant military conflict primarily involving the U.S., Israel and Iran, but which has also involved other countries in the Middle East, has commenced. This conflict has exacerbated certain risks previously disclosed (...) The extent and duration of the current Iran-based conflict remains uncertain and, if it continues unresolved for a meaningful period of time, could materially affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations." (10-Q T2 2026, Part II Item 1A)

controles.affirmation: Obligation REIT de distribuer au moins 90% du resultat imposable
controles.verbatim_source: "REITs are subject to numerous regulatory requirements, including the requirement to generally distribute at least 90% of taxable income each year, excluding any net capital gains." (10-K FY2025)

controles.affirmation: 757,6 M$ de dette a echeance en 2027, plus grosse marche sur 5 ans devant 2026 (166,3), 2028 (390,3), 2029 (527,7) et 2030 (607,6), soit environ 15% d'un encours total de 4,90 Mds$
"Taux d'interet moyen de 4,24% sur la dette a taux fixe ARRIVANT A ECHEANCE en 2026, contre 4,74% a 4,75% sur la dette ARRIVANT A ECHEANCE au-dela de 5 ans"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Item 3 : "The table below presents the principal cash flow payments associated with our outstanding debt by year, weighted average interest rates ON DEBT OUTSTANDING AT EACH YEAR-END, and fair value of total debt as of June 30, 2026." Ligne : "Average interest rate for all fixed rate debt 4.24% | 4.35% | 4.34% | 4.53% | 4.74% | 4.75%" pour les colonnes 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029, 2030 et Thereafter.
controles.correction_proposee: Ces taux ne sont pas ceux des tranches arrivant a echeance : ce sont les taux moyens ponderes de la dette ENCORE EN VIE a la fin de chaque exercice. Reformulation : "le taux moyen de la dette restante passe de 4,24% fin 2026 a 4,75% au-dela de cinq ans, les tranches les moins cheres arrivant a echeance en premier".

controles.affirmation: Emission de fevrier 2026 : 450 M$, echeance 2033, coupon 4,50%, au-dessus du taux contractuel moyen de 4,2% de la dette non securisee a taux fixe
controles.verbatim_source: "On February 18, 2026, the Company issued $450.0 million aggregate principal amount of senior unsecured notes due 2033 (the '2026 Notes'). The 2026 Notes were issued at 99.376% of par and bear interest at a rate of 4.50% per annum." ; tableau de dette : "Fixed rate unsecured debt (...) 4.2 % [taux contractuel] | 4.4 % [taux effectif]" (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: "un levier net de 5,2x l'EBITDA" au 30 juin 2026, source 10-Q T2 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Ni le 10-Q T2 2026 ni le 10-K FY2025 ne contiennent ce ratio. Le chiffre figure dans le communique du T1 2026 : "As of March 31, 2026, Regency's pro-rata net debt and preferred stock to TTM operating EBITDAre was 5.2x" (data-lake/REG/_srctext_60k.txt).
controles.correction_proposee: Le ratio est de 5,2x au 31 MARS 2026 (et non au 30 juin), il inclut les actions preferentielles, et il provient du communique de resultats, pas du 10-Q. Reformuler et resourcer, ou retirer la date du 30 juin.

controles.affirmation: Notation relevee a A- en 2025, environ 1,5 Md$ disponible sur la ligne de credit, croissance du NOI same-property de 5,3% sur l'exercice 2025
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "In February 2025, the Company received a credit rating upgrade to A- with a stable outlook, from S&P Global Ratings." ; "Our Pro-rata same property NOI, excluding termination fees, grew 5.3%, as compared to the year ended December 31, 2024" ; 10-Q T2 2026 : "At June 30, 2026, we had $1.46 billion available on the Line"
